Visitors targeting sea-run Atlantic salmon need the salmon licence category.

An unlicensed visitor under 16 can share an accompanying salmon licence holder's catch-and-release limit.

Foreign children under 16 can fish with a valid licence holder; confirm special-area conditions.

Use barbless hooks.
Stay within daily and possession limits.

Anglers aged 16 or 17 receive a free general licence.

Canadian residents under 16.
Foreign children under 16 when accompanied by a sport fishing licence holder.

Do not use live fish as bait.

whoNeedsOne: People who use methods outside the listed licence exemptions need the Director's licence.
exemptions: Hook-and-line fishing, including jigging, is exempt from the general licence, subject to the area restrictions.

extras.name: Dockyard or French Creek licence
extras.when: For fishing in these restricted harbour areas where the regulations require a special licence.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The ordinary hook-and-line licence exemption applies at sea. Restricted places and methods still have separate conditions.
keyRules: Do not fish in closed or prohibited areas.
Check the special licence rule before fishing in Dockyard or French Creek.
A licence is personal and cannot be transferred.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the Department of Fisheries and Aquaculture for methods or areas that require a licence.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current species permits, catch reporting, boat and charter requirements. No general online purchase route is confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Monaco
jurisdictions.summary: Shore anglers must declare their activity to Maritime Affairs. The current Sea Code requires renewal every three years, and fishing is restricted to authorised shore areas.
whoNeedsOne: People who fish with a line from the shore must make the declaration.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The shore declaration is not confirmation of permission to fish from a boat. Separate sea rules apply to other methods.
keyRules: Use no more than two hooks from the shore.
Fish only in authorised shore areas.
Do not sell the catch.
Return undersized fish, even if dead.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Submit the shore fishing declaration to the Direction des Affaires Maritimes.

sources.title: Shore declaration renewal every three years

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the declaration fee, submission route, and boat or charter requirements. Older pages may state an annual renewal.

jurisdictions.name: Montenegro

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management

jurisdictions.summary: A valid permit is required for recreational fishing in both freshwater and the sea. Freshwater permits come from the water user or protected-area manager, so buy for the chosen water.
whoNeedsOne: Recreational anglers in freshwater and marine waters need the relevant permit.

extras.name: Protected-area fishing permit
extras.when: For water managed by a protected-area authority; obtain its permit for that area.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Marine permits are separate and depend on the activity, such as shore, boat or underwater fishing.
keyRules: Carry the valid permit while fishing.
Observe the permitted sizes and closed seasons.
Do not sell fish caught under a recreational marine permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain freshwater permits from the water manager. Contact the ministry or an authorised issuer for marine permits.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current fees, the exact water coverage, visitor exemptions and guide requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Netherlands
jurisdictions.summary: Most inland fishing requires a VISpas or another valid written permission. Club membership normally includes the VISpas, but it covers only the waters listed for that pass.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in most inland waters need the applicable fishing permission.

extras.name: Permission for other water
extras.when: For water outside the list covered by your VISpas.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Marine anglers aged 14 and above must register in RecFishing, even if they hold a VISpas. Separate marine gear and catch rules apply.
keyRules: Check the permitted water in VISplanner and the list linked to your pass.
Follow the conditions for your permit and chosen water.
Report sea bass, bluefin tuna and European eel catches in RecFishing within 24 hours, including released fish.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy a VISpas online or join an affiliated angling club. The government also describes a more limited Kleine VISpas.

sources.title: VISpas information from the permit issuer
Marine registration and catch reports in 2026

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current club fees, youth conditions, night or extra-rod permissions, and charter requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Norway

authority.name: Norwegian Environment Agency and Directorate of Fisheries

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 18 and above need the national fee payment for salmon, sea trout and migratory Arctic char in rivers and lakes. They also need the local water permit; ordinary freshwater fish require the local permission without that national fee.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 18 and above who fish for migratory salmonids in freshwater must pay the national fee.
Freshwater anglers must obtain the water owner's permission.
exemptions: Anglers under 18 do not pay the national fishing fee. Local permission can still be required.

extras.name: Local fishing licence
extras.when: For the chosen river or lake, including when the national salmon fee is required.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary recreational sea angling does not require a fishing licence. Foreign visitors must use hand-held tackle and must not sell the catch.
keyRules: Stay at least 100 metres from fish farms when fishing.
Observe sea-fish minimum sizes.
In 2026, tourists may export up to 15 kg of sea fish twice a year only through a registered tourist-fishing business.
The export allowance requires the visitor to be at least 12 and carry the required documentation.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Pay the national fee on the Environment Agency portal. Obtain the local licence from the owner or fishery.

sources.title: Rules for fishing in rivers and lakes

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm national fee prices, local youth conditions, salmon closures and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Poland

authority.name: Polish Waters and marine fisheries authorities

jurisdictions.summary: Foreign visitors who stay temporarily in Poland are exempt from the inland angler's card. They still need the permit for the chosen water; the exemption does not provide free access.
whoNeedsOne: Temporary foreign visitors need the water user's inland permit.
Sea anglers must meet the separate marine fee requirements.
exemptions: Foreign nationals who stay temporarily in Poland do not need the karta wędkarska, but still need the water permit.

extras.name: Water-user permit
extras.when: For the specific inland fishing district or water.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Marine recreational fishing uses a separate fee system. An inland water permit does not replace it; individuals must carry payment proof and identification.
keyRules: Use the inland permit only in its listed waters.
Follow the water manager's fishing rules.
Carry the marine fee receipt and identification when that fee applies.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy participating Polish Waters permits through WIR or the WIR app. Other managers issue their own permits.

sources.title: 2026 water permits and foreign visitor exemption

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current permit durations and fees with the water manager. Confirm marine payment details and charter-client requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Portugal

authority.name: ICNF and Directorate-General for Natural Resources, Safety and Maritime Services

jurisdictions.summary: Mainland freshwater and sea fishing use separate licences. Freshwater special fishing zones can also require a local permit in addition to the national, regional or non-resident licence.
whoNeedsOne: Non-resident freshwater anglers need the appropriate ICNF licence.
Marine anglers need the licence for shore, boat or underwater fishing, unless exempt.
exemptions: For marine fishing, children under 16 accompanied by a licensed angler do not need their own licence.

options.name: Mainland boat sea licence, includes shore

extras.name: Special freshwater-zone permit
extras.when: For ZPP or ZPL waters where the manager requires it, in addition to the basic freshwater licence.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The mainland sea licence is separate from freshwater. Boat, shore and underwater licence categories have different coverage.
keyRules: Carry the licence and required identity document.
Use the extra permit for the specific freshwater zone.
Observe marine minimum sizes and protected-species rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact ICNF for a non-resident freshwater licence. Foreign marine applicants can use BMar; allow five working days for normal processing.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: The prices shown are for mainland Portugal. Check Madeira and Azores rules, freshwater exemptions, and charter coverage separately.

jurisdictions.name: Romania

authority.name: National Agency for Fisheries and Aquaculture; Danube Delta Biosphere Reserve Administration

jurisdictions.summary: Recreational fishing in natural waters requires a named permit from the authority or the relevant fishing association. Check the water's manager; the Danube Delta has a separate fishing permit and visitor access permit.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in natural fishing waters need the permit issued for their activity and area.

extras.name: Association water permission
extras.when: For association-managed water, follow the association's approved permit and access procedure.

extras.name: Danube Delta recreational permit
extras.when: For recreational fishing in the reserve; valid with a visitor access permit.

extras.name: Danube Delta one-day visitor access
extras.when: For entry to the reserve unless an access-fee exemption applies.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Romania's fisheries law includes marine waters. Confirm the correct ANPA marine permit before sea fishing.
keyRules: Follow the approved rules for the water's manager.
Do not use natural bait for salmonids.
In the Danube Delta, hold both the fishing permit and the required visitor access permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the official ANPA permit portal or the relevant fishing association. Use the ARBDD portal for Danube Delta permits.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the current visitor procedure, permit fee and validity with ANPA. Check border-water approval and charter requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Serbia
jurisdictions.summary: A day or multi-day permit covers the issuing manager's waters. The ordinary annual permit has wider national coverage, but protected areas require their own permit.
whoNeedsOne: Recreational anglers need a permit unless the child exemption applies.
exemptions: Children under 14 may use one rod without a permit when accompanied by a permit holder.

extras.name: Protected-area fishing permit
extras.when: For the specific protected fishing area; the ordinary annual permit does not cover it.

keyRules: Keep the required catch record.
Return the catch record to the water manager at the end of the year.
Follow local restrictions on tackle and fishing areas.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy from the fishing-area user or the protected-area manager.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the visitor's documents, local sales channel and any distribution fee. Guide coverage is not confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Slovakia
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers need both a municipal fishing card and a permit for the fishing ground. The inexpensive municipal card alone does not authorise access to a river or lake.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers need the fishing card and the water manager's fishing permit.
exemptions: Children under 15 are exempt from the municipal card fee, not from the card requirement.

extras.name: Fishing-ground permit
extras.when: For the chosen water, in addition to the municipal fishing card.

keyRules: Obtain both the card and the fishing-ground permit.
Return the permit with the completed catch record after use, as instructed by the issuer.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply for the card at a municipality. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-ground manager or the Slovak Fishing Union.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the water permit price, return deadline, visitor documents and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Slovenia

authority.name: SPOT government portal and fisheries authorities

jurisdictions.summary: Freshwater fishing requires a permit from the manager of the chosen water. At sea, ordinary shore angling is free, but recreational boat fishing requires a personal permit.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers need the local manager's fishing permit.
Recreational anglers who fish from a boat at sea need a marine permit.
exemptions: Recreational sea fishing from the shore does not require a permit.

extras.name: Freshwater water permit
extras.when: Obtain the permit for the fishing ground from its manager.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Shore fishing is permit-free. Boat anglers can use daily or weekly recreational marine permits.
keyRules: For an online marine permit, buy at least one hour before fishing.
Carry the marine permit; it cannot be transferred.
Do not use live vertebrates as marine bait.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain freshwater permits from the water manager. Marine recreational permits are available online through authorised issuers.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current permit prices, the official marine purchase link and guide-client requirements.

jurisdictions.name: Spain

authority.name: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food; autonomous-community authorities

jurisdictions.summary: The autonomous communities issue fishing licences, with separate freshwater and sea systems. A freshwater licence does not replace a reserved-water permit, and an interregional licence covers only participating communities.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers need the applicable regional or interregional licence.
Marine anglers need the regional licence for their method; some species also require national authorisation.

extras.name: Reserved-water permit
extras.when: For controlled fishing grounds, such as Castilla y Leon cotos, in addition to the basic licence.

extras.name: Special marine-species authorisation
extras.when: For boat fishing targeting species covered by the ministry's special authorisation scheme.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Coastal communities issue shore, boat and underwater licences. The ministry also administers special-species authorisations and the PescaREC declaration system.
keyRules: Check that the licence covers your autonomous community.
Obtain the permit for a reserved freshwater fishing ground.
Declare the required marine catches, including releases, in PescaREC within 24 hours after the fishing activity.
The interregional licence covers Andalusia, Aragon, Castilla-La Mancha, Castilla y Leon, Madrid, Valencia, Extremadura, Galicia, Asturias and Murcia.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply through the chosen autonomous community's official licence service. Obtain reserved-water permits through its separate allocation or sales system.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm visitor identification requirements, local fishing-ground access and charter-client rules.

jurisdictions.name: Sweden

authority.name: County Administrative Boards and Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management

jurisdictions.summary: Ordinary hand-held rod fishing is free along the coast and in the five specified large lakes. Most other waters require the fishing-right holder's permit; public access to the land does not provide that fishing permission.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in other lakes, rivers and streams need the fishing-right holder's permission, usually a local fishing card.
exemptions: Hand-held tackle needs no fishing card along the coast or in Vänern, Vättern, Mälaren, Hjälmaren and Storsjön in Jämtland.
Foreign visitors have the same hand-held tackle rights as Swedish citizens.

extras.name: Local fishing card
extras.when: For water outside the free hand-held fishing areas, or permission directly from the fishing-right holder.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary hand-held rod fishing along the coast needs no fishing card. Species, gear, closed-area and reporting rules still apply.
keyRules: Check the area's rules in Svenska fiskeregler.
Do not use live fish as bait.
Do not fish in closed areas or during the applicable closed season.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain the local fishing card or permission from the fishing-right holder for the chosen water.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm local permit fees, sea catch-report duties, boat methods and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Switzerland

authority.name: Cantonal fisheries authorities; Canton of Bern

jurisdictions.summary: Fishing permissions depend on the canton and the chosen water. Check whether you need a cantonal permit or access through a leased fishery; a permit from one canton is not a national pass.
whoNeedsOne: Visitors must meet the permit and qualification requirements for the canton and water.
In Bern, non-residents can buy cantonal fishing permits.

extras.name: Leased-water permission
extras.when: For water where the fishing rights belong to a leaseholder, such as Zurich fishing districts.

keyRules: In Bern, permits for 30 days or longer require recognised fishing competence proof.
In Bern, short-permit anglers without that proof must read the official fish-welfare information.
Follow the permit's water boundaries and cantonal fishing rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the canton or fishery's permit service. Bern sells permits online, through Fischen Bern and through listed agents.

sources.title: Zurich fishing waters and fishing rights

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm fees, SaNa or foreign-qualification acceptance, free-fishing exceptions and guide requirements with the chosen canton.

jurisdictions.name: Turkey
jurisdictions.summary: Foreign tourists may fish from the sea shore without an ordinary permit. Sea-boat and inland trips follow the licensed tourism-operator or provincial fishing-voucher route; shore freedom does not cover these trips.
whoNeedsOne: Foreign tourists who fish from a sea boat or in inland waters must follow the visitor authorisation route.
Foreign residents use the guest amateur fishing document.
Speargun users need the required diving-method fishing document from 1 January 2026.
exemptions: Foreign tourists can fish from the sea shore without an ordinary permit, subject to the method and conservation rules.

extras.name: Foreign-tourist fishing voucher
extras.when: For the provincial or district authorisation route for inland or sea-boat fishing.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The ordinary foreign-tourist shore exemption differs from boat fishing. Speargun use has a separate document requirement.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: The rules provide a route through operators with a commercial amateur fishing tourism permit. Confirm that the operator holds this permit for your trip.
keyRules: Do not use live fish as bait in inland waters.
Do not sell the recreational catch.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the provincial or district agriculture office for visitor documents, or use a licensed fishing-tourism operator.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm voucher duration, fees, local access and the documents required for the operator route.

jurisdictions.name: England & Wales
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 13 and above need a rod licence for salmon, trout, freshwater fish, smelt or eel. They also need the land or fishery owner's permission, including on private fishing lakes.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 13 and above who target the listed species in England, Wales or the Border Esk region.
The River Tweed is outside this licence system.
exemptions: Children under 13 need no rod licence.
Children aged 13–16 need a free junior licence.
A carer who does not fish needs no licence.

options.name: Trout and coarse, up to two rods
Trout and coarse, up to two rods
Trout and coarse, up to two rods

extras.name: Fishery or club permit
extras.when: Required permission for the chosen water, in addition to the rod licence.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Targeting salmon or sea trout requires the appropriate rod licence. Confirm the rules for other tidal species and locations.
keyRules: Show a valid rod licence when requested.
Observe the rod limits for the licence and species.
Submit the annual salmon and sea trout catch return even if you did not fish.
Follow national and local fishing byelaws.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy online through GOV.UK or call the Environment Agency licence service on 0344 800 5386.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the fishery ticket, local season and any guided-trip package.

jurisdictions.name: Scotland
jurisdictions.summary: Scotland generally has no national recreational rod licence, but freshwater anglers need permission from the fishing-right holder. The Border Esk region is an exception and uses the England and Wales rod licence as well.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers need the relevant fishery permit or written permission.
Anglers in the Border Esk must also meet the England and Wales rod licence rules.
exemptions: Outside the Border Esk exception, Scotland does not require a national recreational fishing licence.

extras.name: Fishery permit or written permission
extras.when: From the owner of the fishing rights for the chosen water.

keyRules: Do not fish for salmon with a rod on Sunday.
The brown trout closed season runs from 7 October to 14 March.
Check the owner of the fishing rights; the landowner can be a different person.
Follow the conditions of the fishery permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain permission from the fishery or fishing-right holder. The local fisheries board or trust can identify the correct contact.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm local prices, salmon closures, coastal permission and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Northern Ireland

authority.name: Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs and Loughs Agency

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers need a rod licence for the correct DAERA or Loughs Agency area and a separate water permit or day ticket. An England and Wales licence does not cover Northern Ireland.
whoNeedsOne: DAERA anglers aged 12 and above need the applicable rod licence.
Anglers of all ages need a licence in the Loughs Agency area.
exemptions: In the DAERA area, children under 12 do not need a rod licence. Water-permit conditions still apply.

extras.name: Water permit or day ticket
extras.when: For the chosen public, club or private fishery, in addition to the rod licence.

extras.name: DAERA/Loughs Agency endorsement
extras.when: To extend the relevant rod licence to both authorities' areas; water permission remains separate.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary sea angling needs no rod licence. Salmon and sea trout require a game rod licence.
keyRules: Use the licence for the correct authority's area.
Do not split a short-term licence across non-consecutive dates.
A DAERA game licence allows only one rod at a time.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy DAERA licences and public-water permits online or from distributors. Use the Loughs Agency eLicence service for its area.

sources.title: Rod licences and separate water permits
DAERA game licence ages and exemptions

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Check Loughs Agency prices, the specific water permit and guide arrangements.

jurisdictions.name: Alabama

authority.name: Alabama Department of Conservation and Natural Resources

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 16 or older need the correct freshwater or saltwater licence. The senior exemption applies to Alabama residents, not visiting seniors.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents aged 16 or older.
exemptions: Children under 16.
Alabama residents aged 65 or older; saltwater registration can still apply.

extras.name: Gulf Reef Fish Endorsement
extras.when: Required from age 16 to take, attempt to take, or possess listed Gulf reef fish.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Saltwater areas require a separate licence. Fees can depend on the visitor's home state.
keyRules: Annual recreational licences expire August 31.
The public fishing lakes licence covers only state-owned county public fishing lakes.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Online through Outdoor Alabama, at licence agents or department offices, or by phone at 1-888-848-6887.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm residence-based fees and charter coverage. The saltwater fee table is dated August 2025. Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link.

jurisdictions.name: Alaska

authority.name: Alaska Department of Fish and Game

jurisdictions.summary: Non-residents aged 16 or older need a sport fishing licence. A king salmon stamp is normally required even when you release the fish.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents aged 16 or older.
Residents aged 18 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Non-residents under 16; harvest records can still apply.
Resident seniors aged 60 or older with the required ADF&G identification card.

extras.name: Non-resident king salmon stamp, 1-day
extras.when: Required to fish for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.

extras.name: Sport Fishing Harvest Record Card
extras.when: Required for licence-exempt anglers in fisheries with annual harvest limits.

extras.name: Non-resident king salmon stamp, 3-day
extras.when: Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.

extras.name: Non-resident king salmon stamp, 7-day
extras.when: Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.

extras.name: Non-resident king salmon stamp, 14-day
extras.when: Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.

extras.name: Non-resident king salmon stamp, annual
extras.when: Required when fishing for king salmon, except stocked lakes and exempt anglers.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The sport fishing licence covers fresh and salt water.
keyRules: Record catches subject to annual harvest limits.
Annual licences and annual king salmon stamps follow the calendar year.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy through ADF&G's online licence service or a licence vendor.

sources.title: Sport fishing licences and king salmon stamps

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Check current fishery restrictions and annual harvest-record requirements before each outing.

jurisdictions.name: Arizona
jurisdictions.summary: Residents and visitors aged 10 or older need a licence for publicly accessible waters. Children aged 10 to 17 need the youth licence.
whoNeedsOne: Residents and non-residents aged 10 or older in publicly accessible water.
exemptions: Children under 10.
Blind Arizona residents.
keyRules: Annual licences last 365 days.
Purchased licences cannot be exchanged or refunded.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the online purchase links on the department's fishing licence page.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm tribal-water permits, local rules, and guide coverage with the relevant authority. Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link.

jurisdictions.name: Arkansas
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. A trout permit also applies in specified trout waters, even if you keep no trout.
whoNeedsOne: Anyone aged 16 or older who takes or attempts to take aquatic wildlife.
exemptions: Children under 16.
Anglers at licensed put-and-take pay lakes.

options.name: Non-resident 3-day
options.duration: 72 hours from the selected start time

extras.name: Non-resident trout permit
extras.when: Required to retain trout anywhere or fish specified trout waters.

jurisdictions.guidedTrips: A guide licence does not include fishing privileges. Clients need their own required licence and trout permit.
keyRules: Carry your valid fishing licence.
The trout permit applies to designated tailwaters and the specified part of Spavinaw Creek.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Online, at licence agents, or at AGFC regional offices.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link.

jurisdictions.name: California

authority.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a sport fishing licence in fresh or ocean water. Children and public-pier anglers can still need species report cards.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 16.
Fishing from a qualifying public pier in ocean or bay waters; species report cards can still apply.

extras.name: Ocean Enhancement Validation
extras.when: Ocean fishing south of Point Arguello; not required with one-day or two-day licences.

extras.name: Species report cards
extras.when: Required for specified species and areas, including steelhead and sturgeon.

extras.name: Second Rod Validation
extras.when: Eligible inland fishing with two rods; not waters restricted to artificial lures or barbless hooks.

jurisdictions.saltwater: The same licence covers ocean fishing. Southern ocean waters can require an extra validation.
keyRules: Report-card duties can apply even without a licence.
A second-rod validation applies to eligible inland two-rod fishing.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use CDFW online licence sales or a licence agent. Eligible licences can appear in the CDFW License App.

sources.title: Sport fishing licences and report cards

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current report-card prices, species closures, and charter requirements.
jurisdictions.freeFishingDays: CDFW lists July 3 and September 4, 2027 as free fishing days. Species report cards and other fishing rules still apply.

jurisdictions.name: Colorado
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Most adults also pay for a Habitat Stamp; the first two daily licences are exempt.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 16 or older.
exemptions: Children under 16 need no base fishing licence.

extras.name: Habitat Stamp
extras.when: Usually required once yearly for buyers aged 18–64; the first two one-day/additional-day licences are exempt.

extras.name: Second-rod stamp
extras.when: Required to use a second rod, including for children under 16.

keyRules: The 2026 annual licence ends March 31, 2027.
Show acceptable identification when you buy a licence.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Online, at CPW offices or licence agents, or by phone at 1-800-244-5613.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm whether a guided trip covers the client's licence.

jurisdictions.name: Connecticut

authority.name: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 16 or older need inland, marine, or all-waters coverage. The trout and salmon stamp applies in some managed waters even for catch and release.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 16 or older in inland or marine waters, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 16.
Eligible marine anglers with recognised reciprocal state licences.

extras.name: Trout and Salmon Stamp
extras.when: Required to keep trout or salmon, or fish designated trout/salmon management waters, unless exempt.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Use a marine or all-waters licence. Reciprocity depends on the other state and residency.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Passengers on CT DEEP-registered party or charter vessels are exempt from the marine licence requirement.
keyRules: Annual licences expire December 31.
Online licences are electronically signed; agent-issued licences must be printed and signed.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use CT Outdoor Licenses, participating retailers and town halls, or selected DEEP offices.

jurisdictions.name: Delaware

authority.name: Delaware Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Control

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 16 or older need a licence for fresh and tidal waters. A licence exemption does not always remove the separate FIN registration requirement.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents aged 16 or older.
Recreational fish, crab, and clam harvesters, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 16 need no general fishing licence.
Resident seniors have an exemption that does not extend to visiting seniors.

extras.name: Fisherman Information Network number
extras.when: Required registration; issued with most individual fishing licences.

extras.name: Non-resident trout stamp
extras.when: Required from age 12 in designated trout streams during the stated spring and autumn periods.

jurisdictions.saltwater: One general licence covers fresh and tidal waters, including recreational crabs and clams.
keyRules: A non-resident boat licence does not cover fishing from shore.
The surf-vehicle permit exemption covers the vehicle operator, not every passenger.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use Digital DNREC, authorised licence agents, or the DNREC licensing desk in Dover. Agent fees can apply.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm whether a guided trip covers the client's licence.

jurisdictions.name: Florida

authority.name: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 16 or older need freshwater or saltwater coverage for the species they target. The free shoreline licence is only for Florida residents.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents aged 16 or older, including anglers who release their catch.
exemptions: Children under 16.
Saltwater anglers on properly licensed charter vessels or licensed piers.

extras.name: Snook permit
extras.when: Required when taking or attempting to take snook unless a permit exemption applies. Check current FWC rules before targeting snook.

extras.name: Spiny lobster permit
extras.when: Required for lobster take or attempted take unless exempt.

extras.name: State Reef Fish Angler designation
extras.when: Required from age 16 for specified reef fish from a private vessel, including many licence-exempt anglers.

extras.name: Shore-based Shark Fishing permit

authority.name: Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management

jurisdictions.summary: Freshwater anglers need a licence from age 15; marine anglers generally need one from age 16. The two licences have different annual expiry dates.
whoNeedsOne: Freshwater anglers aged 15 or older.
Marine finfish anglers and spearfishers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 15 in freshwater and under 16 in saltwater.
Marine anglers on licensed party or charter boats.

options.name: Non-resident freshwater annual
options.duration: March 1 through the last day of February

extras.name: Trout Conservation Stamp
extras.when: Required to keep trout, salmon or char, or fish designated catch-and-release or fly-only areas, unless exempt.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Separate marine coverage applies. DEM also recognises specified reciprocal licences and NOAA registration.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Licensed party and charter boats cover the individual marine licence requirement.
keyRules: Non-residents may not harvest blue crabs.
Non-residents need separate shellfish coverage; lobster also has a separate licence.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use Rhode Island Outdoors, participating vendors, or town clerks for eligible products.

jurisdictions.name: South Carolina

authority.name: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 16 or older generally need freshwater or saltwater coverage. A licence is required from the beach unless an exemption applies.
whoNeedsOne: Recreational anglers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 16 for ordinary recreational angling.
Saltwater anglers on licensed public piers or hired licensed charter vessels.

extras.name: Shrimp baiting licence and tags
extras.when: Required for shrimp baiting during the authorised season.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Separate coverage applies. The boundary is usually US 17, but named exceptions change it.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: A hired SCDNR-licensed saltwater charter vessel covers clients' individual saltwater licence requirement.
keyRules: Carry the required licence while you fish.
Nongame fishing devices can require extra permits, including for children.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the SCDNR online licence service or a licence agent.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link.

jurisdictions.name: South Dakota

authority.name: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 18 or older need a fishing licence. A visitor's three-day licence also needs a Habitat Stamp, while the one-day licence does not.
whoNeedsOne: Residents and non-residents aged 18 or older.
exemptions: Children under 18 can fish and keep their own limit without a licence.

extras.name: Non-resident Habitat Stamp
extras.when: Required once per licence year from age 18 with most licences; one-day fishing licences are exempt.

keyRules: The one-day licence ends at midnight.
Licences cannot be transferred or refunded.
The listed prices exclude agent fees.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the GFP online licence service, retail stores, bait shops, or participating county treasurers.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm whether a guided trip covers the client's licence.

jurisdictions.name: Tennessee
jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 13 or older need a fishing licence. Adult visitors who target trout need an all-species licence, not the cheaper no-trout option.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents aged 13 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children aged 12 or younger need no base licence; special permits can still apply.

extras.name: Tellico-Citico trout permit
extras.when: Required for all ages March 1–August 15 in the specified waters; daily permit.

keyRules: Special-water permits do not replace the base licence.
Processing fees apply to purchases.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use Go Outdoors Tennessee, a TWRA licence agent, or a regional office.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm special-water permits and guide coverage. Check the purchase service for the effective date of future fee changes.

jurisdictions.name: Texas
jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 17 or older generally need a fishing licence and the correct water endorsement. Foreign residents must buy in person under the August 2026 identification rules.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents aged 17 or older who fish in public waters, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 17.
Oklahoma residents aged 65 or older.
Louisiana residents aged 65 or older with a valid Louisiana recreational fishing licence.

extras.name: Freshwater or saltwater endorsement
extras.when: Included in the matching package; a one-day all-water licence needs no separate endorsement.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Choose a saltwater or all-water package. The freshwater package alone does not provide saltwater coverage.
keyRules: Annual visitor packages end August 31.
Since August 3, 2026, each buyer aged 17 or older must meet the individual ID-validation rules.
Foreign residents cannot buy online.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy online after ID validation or in person at a licence retailer. Foreign residents must use an in-person seller.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm whether a guided trip covers the client's licence.

jurisdictions.name: Utah
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 12 or older need a fishing licence. The reduced senior price applies to residents, not visiting seniors.
whoNeedsOne: Residents and non-residents aged 12 or older.
exemptions: Children aged 11 or younger.

extras.name: Non-resident setline permit
extras.when: Required to use a setline, with a valid fishing licence.

keyRules: The setline permit is valid only with the fishing licence.
Online and in-person card payments have a 2.2 percent transaction fee.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use DWR's online licence service or an in-person licence seller.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm boundary-water coverage and guide requirements before the trip. Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link.

jurisdictions.name: Vermont
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 15 or older need a fishing licence. A short-term licence covers consecutive dates, not separate days across a trip.
whoNeedsOne: Residents and visitors aged 15 or older.
exemptions: Children under 15.
keyRules: All short-term licence dates are inclusive and consecutive.
A parent or guardian must sign for a licence buyer aged 15 or younger.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy online, at participating licence agents, or at department district offices.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm whether a guided trip covers the client's licence.

jurisdictions.name: Virginia

authority.name: Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources; Marine Resources Commission

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors need the correct freshwater or saltwater coverage unless exempt. Designated stocked trout waters can require an additional trout licence.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children under 16 need no fishing or trout licence.
Anglers aged 65 or older need no saltwater licence, but FIP registration requirements remain.

extras.name: Non-resident stocked-trout licence
extras.when: Required when designated stocked trout-water rules apply, in addition to freshwater coverage.

extras.name: Fisherman Identification Program registration
extras.when: Applies to specified saltwater anglers exempt from a licence.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Separate saltwater coverage or a combined licence is available. Licence-exempt anglers can still need FIP registration.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: A licensed saltwater charter boat, headboat, or pier covers the individual saltwater licence requirement.
keyRules: A designated trout-area daily-use permit can be required.
Carry the licence and show it on request; an electronic copy is accepted.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use Go Outdoors Virginia, its mobile app, licence agents, DWR headquarters, or 804-367-1000.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm trout-permit dates, FIP registration, and any special-area permit.

jurisdictions.name: Washington

authority.name: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife

jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 16 or older need the correct fishing licence. Children can still need catch record cards and species endorsements.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 16 or older.
Anglers of all ages who need a catch record card for their target species.
exemptions: Anglers aged 15 or younger need no base fishing licence; catch records and some endorsements remain.

extras.name: Fish catch record card
extras.when: Required for covered species such as salmon, steelhead and sturgeon; separate halibut charges can apply.

extras.name: Columbia River salmon and steelhead endorsement
extras.when: Required from age 15 for salmon or steelhead in the Columbia and its tributaries; youth rates differ.

extras.name: Puget Sound crab endorsement
extras.when: Required for Puget Sound Dungeness crab.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Choose saltwater or combination coverage; shellfish and crab can need additional coverage.
keyRules: Temporary licences do not replace required catch record cards.
Short-term combination licences require consecutive dates.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use MyWDFW or Fish Washington mobile licensing, online sales, licence dealers, or 360-902-2464.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm catch-record returns, endorsement fees for your age and term, emergency closures, and guide coverage. Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link.

jurisdictions.name: West Virginia

authority.name: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors aged 15 or older need fishing coverage. The low daily licence price excludes the mandatory Conservation/Law Enforcement Stamp.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents aged 15 or older.
exemptions: Children under 15 need no general fishing licence.

extras.name: Conservation/Law Enforcement Stamp, CS/LE
extras.when: Required with non-resident Class F, LL and XXJ licences.

extras.name: Non-resident trout stamp, OO
extras.when: Required for licensed anglers who fish for trout.

extras.name: National Forest stamp, I
extras.when: Required on National Forests with the specified non-resident fishing licences.

keyRules: A one-day licence still needs the CS/LE stamp.
National Forest coverage is separate from trout and base fishing coverage.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy online through WVDNR or through a licence agent or DNR office.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link. Confirm whether a guided trip covers the client's licence.

jurisdictions.name: Wisconsin
jurisdictions.summary: Most anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. A normal one-day licence still needs a trout or salmon stamp for those species.
whoNeedsOne: Residents and visitors aged 16 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Children aged 15 or younger.

extras.name: Inland Trout Stamp
extras.when: Required for inland trout fishing unless exempt.

extras.name: Great Lakes Salmon/Trout Stamp
extras.when: Required for Great Lakes trout or salmon unless exempt or included in the licence.

keyRules: The two-day Great Lakes licence includes its salmon/trout stamp.
Sturgeon harvest uses separate licences and season rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use Go Wild online or a DNR licence vendor.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm whether a guided trip covers the client's licence.

jurisdictions.name: Wyoming
jurisdictions.summary: Anglers aged 14 or older generally need a fishing licence. A state licence does not provide Yellowstone National Park fishing coverage.
whoNeedsOne: Residents and visitors aged 14 or older, unless exempt.
exemptions: Non-residents under 14 can fish with an adult who holds a valid Wyoming fishing licence; catch-limit conditions apply.

extras.name: Conservation Stamp
extras.when: Required with most annual fishing licences; daily licences have an exemption.

extras.name: Yellowstone National Park permit
extras.when: Required separately under park rules; see the federal record.

keyRules: The annual licence lasts 12 months.
Yellowstone has separate fishing permit rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the department's official licence purchase service.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the five-day Conservation Stamp exemption, child catch limits, tribal permits, and guide coverage. Use the authority page to confirm the current online purchase link.

jurisdictions.name: US federal waters and national parks

authority.name: NOAA Fisheries and National Park Service

jurisdictions.summary: Atlantic HMS trips require the appropriate vessel permit for tunas, billfish, swordfish, and sharks. National parks apply park-specific rules; Yellowstone needs its own permit instead of a state fishing licence.
whoNeedsOne: Vessels that fish for covered Atlantic HMS species.
Yellowstone anglers aged 16 or older.
exemptions: Yellowstone children aged 15 or younger may fish under a permitted adult's direct supervision or obtain a free signed child permit.

extras.name: HMS shark endorsement
extras.when: Required to fish for sharks under an HMS Angling or Charter/Headboat permit; training and a quiz apply.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Atlantic HMS permits concern the Atlantic, Gulf, and Caribbean management area. Check other federal fisheries and state landing requirements separately.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: For-hire HMS trips use the vessel's HMS Charter/Headboat permit. Check each state's client licence rules and each park's permit rules.
keyRules: HMS permits attach to the vessel and require annual renewal.
HMS Angling vessels cannot sell their catch.
Yellowstone prohibits felt-soled fishing footwear.
Yellowstone requires barbless hooks and lead-free artificial lures or flies.
Park closures and special rules can override otherwise applicable state rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy HMS permits through NOAA's permit portal. Buy Yellowstone permits through Recreation.gov or local permit sellers.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current HMS reporting, species closures, shark endorsement fees, and the specific park's permit rules.

jurisdictions.name: Angola

authority.name: Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources

jurisdictions.summary: Recreational anglers need an annual personal licence, including foreign visitors. A tourist fishing boat also needs approval, so do not treat the boat's licence as your own.
whoNeedsOne: Resident and visiting recreational anglers.

extras.name: Tourist fishing vessel licence
extras.when: For a tourist fishing boat.

keyRules: Do not sell recreational catch.
An angler under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's express permission.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply to the fisheries ministry or the relevant provincial government.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current fees and any amendments with the provincial fisheries office.

jurisdictions.name: Australian Capital Territory
jurisdictions.summary: No recreational fishing licence is required in public ACT waters. Googong Reservoir is in New South Wales, so the NSW fishing fee applies despite ACT management.

extras.name: NSW recreational fishing fee
extras.when: For Googong Reservoir, unless a NSW exemption applies.

keyRules: Use no more than two rods.
Stay within 10 metres of your rods and keep them in sight.
Do not use live fish, fish eggs or frogs as bait.
Release protected fish.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: No ACT licence purchase is required. Pay the NSW fee before fishing at Googong unless exempt.

jurisdictions.name: New South Wales

authority.name: NSW Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development

jurisdictions.summary: Most adult anglers must pay the recreational fishing fee in fresh and salt water. A charter covers you only if the operator holds a recreational fishing fee exemption certificate.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 18 or over, unless exempt.
People who collect bait or use fishing gear beside the water.
exemptions: Children under 18.
Aboriginal people.
An adult who helps a child with one rod.
Eligible concession card holders; a Seniors Card alone does not qualify.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The same fee covers freshwater and saltwater.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Ask whether the operator holds a fee exemption certificate. Otherwise, each client must pay unless personally exempt.
keyRules: Carry your fee receipt.
Observe the fishing rules even if you are exempt from the fee.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Pay online through Service NSW, at an agent, or by phone on 1300 369 365.

jurisdictions.name: Northern Territory
jurisdictions.summary: The Northern Territory has no general recreational fishing licence. Some Aboriginal waters require a permit or registration, even when no fishing licence is needed.

extras.name: Aboriginal land or intertidal access permit
extras.when: Where the relevant land council requires a permit or registration.

jurisdictions.saltwater: No general recreational licence applies to saltwater fishing.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Fishing tour operators need a licence. Recreational catch rules still apply to their clients.
keyRules: Release protected fish.
Do not sell or barter recreational catch.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Check the land council's access map and permit service for your fishing location.

jurisdictions.name: Queensland
jurisdictions.summary: Queensland has no general recreational fishing licence. Anglers aged 18 or over need a Stocked Impoundment Permit to use a line in listed dams and weirs.
whoNeedsOne: People aged 18 or over who use a fishing line in a SIPS dam or weir.
exemptions: Anglers under 18 do not need a SIPS permit.
jurisdictions.saltwater: No general marine recreational licence applies; marine park zones and fishing limits still apply.
keyRules: Carry your SIPS permit; a digital copy is acceptable.
Check whether your dam or weir appears in the permit scheme.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy through the Queensland Government's Australia Post service, by phone on 1300 575 359, or at Queensland Australia Post outlets.

sources.title: Great Barrier Reef Marine Park management

jurisdictions.name: South Australia

authority.name: Primary Industries and Regions South Australia

jurisdictions.summary: South Australia has no general recreational fishing licence. A reservoir fishing permit is required at reservoirs open to fishing.

extras.name: Reservoir fishing permit
extras.when: For fishing at reservoirs that allow public fishing.

jurisdictions.saltwater: No general saltwater recreational licence is required.
keyRules: Fish only in the permitted reservoir areas.
Follow the reservoir's catch and access rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the reservoir permit link on PIRSA's reservoir fishing page.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the current reservoir permit price and any special gear registrations.

jurisdictions.name: Tasmania
jurisdictions.summary: An inland angling licence is required from age 14, including for most farm dams. Ordinary sea fishing with a rod needs no licence, but several marine methods and species need separate licences.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers aged 14 or over in inland waters.
exemptions: Children under 14 may use one rod without an inland licence.
Anglers aged 14–17 still need an inland licence, but it is free.
Registered private fisheries have separate arrangements.

extras.name: Marine fishing licence
extras.when: For rock lobster, abalone, scallops, specified nets or set lines.

extras.name: Whitebait licence
extras.when: For recreational whitebait fishing under its separate rules.

jurisdictions.saltwater: No licence is required for ordinary rod and line fishing. Marine licences run from 1 November to 31 October.
keyRules: Buy the correct one-rod or two-rod licence.
Check the open season for your inland water.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy inland licences online, through Service Tasmania or licence agents. Buy marine licences through the Tasmanian recreational sea fishing portal.

jurisdictions.name: Victoria
jurisdictions.summary: Most anglers aged 18 to 69 need a recreational fishing licence. The same licence covers fresh and salt water, but another state's licence does not cover Victoria.
whoNeedsOne: People who take or try to take fish, bait or shellfish from public waters, unless exempt.
exemptions: People under 18 or aged 70 and over.
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.
Holders of the specified senior, veteran and pensioner concession cards.
jurisdictions.saltwater: The licence includes marine and estuary fishing.
keyRules: Do not lend or transfer your licence.
Carry evidence if you claim a concession exemption.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Buy online through Service Victoria or from an authorised licence agent.

jurisdictions.name: Western Australia

authority.name: WA Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development

jurisdictions.summary: Western Australia licenses specific fishing activities. A powered boat can trigger the boat licence rule even when it only transports your gear to a shore fishing spot.
whoNeedsOne: People who fish from a powered boat, subject to the stated exemptions.
South-west freshwater anglers and people who fish for licensed species or use licensed methods.
exemptions: Children under 16 do not need the south-west freshwater licence.
Boat-licence exemptions include licensed fishing charters and non-powered boats.
An unlicensed boat angler may share a licensed angler's bag limit.

extras.name: Species or method licence
extras.when: Separate licences apply to rock lobster, abalone, marron and net fishing.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Ordinary shore angling does not trigger the boat licence. Species and method licences can still apply.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: A licensed fishing charter exempts clients from the boat licence. Other species and method licences remain separate.
keyRules: Produce your licence when an officer asks.
If you share a licence holder's bag limit, the group's combined catch must stay within that limit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply through DoTDirect, by post or at a Department of Transport licensing office.

jurisdictions.name: Bhutan

authority.name: Department of Forests and Park Services

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors need a fishing permit for the approved water and dates. Foreign anglers must use a Bhutanese fishing guide and release their catch.
whoNeedsOne: Foreign visitors who fish in approved recreational waters.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: A Bhutanese fishing guide is compulsory for foreign anglers. Each angler must appear on the permit application.
keyRules: Release each fish immediately.
Use an artificial fly or lure with one single barbless hook.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply through Online Forestry Services. Enter your passport number, fishing area and start date.

sources.title: Consolidated Forest and Nature Conservation Rules 2023–2025, sections 194–196

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the fee and approved fishing dates with the issuing forest or park office.

jurisdictions.name: Botswana

authority.name: Department of Wildlife and National Parks

jurisdictions.summary: Recreational anglers need a licence, including visitors. A lodge booking does not replace the licence or a dam entrance permit.
whoNeedsOne: Citizens and non-citizens aged 18 or over can apply.

extras.name: Water Utilities Corporation entrance permit
extras.when: For access to corporation dams.

keyRules: The open season runs from 1 March to 31 December.
Provide a certified passport copy and the required lodge letter or dam permit.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Submit the recreational fishing licence form and documents at a Wildlife and National Parks office.

sources.title: Department of Wildlife and National Parks

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: The published fee categories use citizenship, not residence. Confirm rules for anglers under 18 and the current fee.

jurisdictions.name: Cameroon

authority.name: Ministry of Livestock, Fisheries and Animal Industries

jurisdictions.summary: Sport fishing uses a Permit B. Visitors should arrange it before travel: the published application process allows 60 days.
whoNeedsOne: Applicants who wish to practise sport fishing.
keyRules: State the requested fishing zones and number of boats in the application.
Provide the required identity document, photographs and gear details.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply to the ministry's inland and artisanal marine fisheries service; collect the issued permit.

sources.title: Ministry of Livestock, Fisheries and Animal Industries

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm visitor eligibility, permit duration, fees and guide coverage with MINEPIA.

jurisdictions.name: Cook Islands

authority.name: Ministry of Marine Resources / Aitutaki Island Council

jurisdictions.summary: Visitors to Aitutaki and Manuae need local lagoon fishing permission. Bonefish waters also have guide, gear and closed-area rules; an offshore charter booking does not settle lagoon access.
whoNeedsOne: Non-Cook Islanders who fish in Aitutaki and Manuae lagoons and surrounding reefs.

extras.name: Visitor Lagoon Fishing Permit
extras.when: For visitors who fish in the Aitutaki and Manuae lagoons and surrounding reefs.

jurisdictions.guidedTrips: The bonefish fishery has fishing guide requirements. Confirm the approved guide and your visitor permit with the island council.
keyRules: Stay out of bonefish nursery and spawning closures.
Do not export bonefish.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Ask Aitutaki Island Council for the current visitor lagoon permit.

sources.title: Ministry of Marine Resources Aitutaki and Manuae booklet
Government marine park legal review, visitor lagoon permits

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current fees, duration and permit rules on other islands. A nationwide personal licence exemption is not confirmed.

jurisdictions.name: Egypt

authority.name: Lakes and Fish Resources Protection and Development Agency

jurisdictions.summary: Fishing normally requires a fishing card, but a limited rod-and-line exemption uses a separate certificate. Foreign visitors can receive this certificate only at approved tourist locations in the Red Sea and South Sinai.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers who require a fishing card or the specific exemption certificate.
exemptions: The exemption certificate permits one rod or line with no more than three hooks, subject to its conditions.

extras.name: Fishing-card exemption certificate
extras.when: For qualifying limited rod-and-line fishing; foreign visitors are restricted to approved tourist locations.

keyRules: Carry the exemption certificate and show it on request.
Follow the certificate's gear and area conditions.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply through the competent fisheries office. Non-resident foreigners must provide passport, return-flight, hotel and responsible tourism-company details.

sources.title: Executive Regulations 706/2023, articles 40–42, official gazette copy

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm current fees, approved visitor locations, boat permits and protected-area restrictions with the fisheries office and EEAA.

jurisdictions.name: Federated States of Micronesia
jurisdictions.summary: Foreign recreational fishing in the national exclusive economic zone requires the applicable NORMA permit. State waters have separate rules, so national vessel approval does not settle reef or lagoon access.
whoNeedsOne: Operators undertaking foreign recreational fishing in the national exclusive economic zone.

extras.name: NORMA foreign recreational fishing permit
extras.when: For foreign recreational fishing covered by the national Marine Resources Act.

jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact NORMA for offshore permits and the relevant state authority for coastal waters.

sources.title: FSM Marine Resources Code, national and state jurisdiction

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the definition of foreign recreational fishing for your vessel and personal visitor permits in Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei or Yap.

jurisdictions.name: Fiji
jurisdictions.summary: Fiji has no individual recreational fishing licence for visitors. A commercial charter must hold the appropriate licence, and customary fishing rights still apply.
exemptions: Charter clients use the licensed operator's cover, according to Tourism Fiji.

extras.name: Operator licence and qoliqoli access
extras.when: The charter must address commercial licensing and customary fishing rights.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Local communities hold traditional fishing rights in qoliqoli areas.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Tourism Fiji states that the commercial operator's fishing licence covers its clients.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Book a licensed charter and ask how it arranges qoliqoli access.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: For independent shore or reef fishing, confirm local permission and closed areas with the Fisheries Ministry.

jurisdictions.name: Gabon
jurisdictions.summary: Sport anglers need a personal fishing permit. A tour operator must check each client's permit; its business status does not replace yours.
whoNeedsOne: People who practise recreational or sport fishing.

extras.name: Protected-area permission
extras.when: Where a national park, marine park or aquatic reserve imposes separate access rules.

jurisdictions.guidedTrips: The operator has responsibility for valid permits for its clients and staff.
keyRules: Do not target fully protected species.
Do not sell or barter the catch.
Do not transfer your personal permit.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the issuing office, visitor fees, duration and protected-area conditions.

jurisdictions.name: Gambia

authority.name: Ministry of Fisheries and Water Resources

jurisdictions.summary: The official licence service lists sport-fishing vessel permits. It does not state whether each visiting angler needs a personal permit, so confirm this before a shore or charter trip.
whoNeedsOne: Owners or agents of vessels that require registration and a fishing licence.

extras.name: Foreign sport-fishing vessel licence
extras.when: For a foreign sport-fishing vessel; this is a vessel fee, not an angler ticket.

jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the Ministry of Fisheries and Water Resources; its online service handles vessel registration and licences.

sources.title: Ministry of Fisheries and Water Resources

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm personal visitor requirements, vessel permit duration, local restrictions and charter client coverage.

jurisdictions.name: Guinea-Bissau
jurisdictions.summary: The ministry states that fishing requires a licence except for subsistence fishing. This does not confirm a tourist exemption; ask for the sport-fishing requirements for your exact area.
whoNeedsOne: People engaged in fishing outside the ministry's subsistence exemption.
exemptions: Subsistence fishing is exempt under the ministry's published guidance; visitor eligibility is not stated.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the fisheries ministry for the appropriate licence category.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the visitor permit, fee, duration, charter coverage and any protected-area permission.

jurisdictions.name: India
jurisdictions.summary: Visitors must check the permit for each state and water. Himachal Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir issue local angling licences; neither licence provides nationwide cover.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in Himachal Pradesh's regulated trout and general waters.
Trout anglers in Jammu and Kashmir.

options.name: Jammu and Kashmir foreign angler trout permit

keyRules: Use the permit for its approved water.
In Himachal Pradesh trout waters, the licence rules prohibit trout fishing from November through February.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Use the relevant state Fisheries Department. Jammu and Kashmir advertises online trout permits; Himachal Pradesh lists local licence offices.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: These are state examples. Confirm current rules for your state, coast, park and exact water.

jurisdictions.name: Indonesia
jurisdictions.summary: The official system lists business approvals for fishing tourism and guides. It does not confirm a general personal licence rule for visitors; check the exact water before you fish.

extras.name: Fishing tourism operator approval
extras.when: For businesses that provide fishing facilities or guided fishing trips.

extras.name: Surat Izin Wisata Bahari
extras.when: For a fishing tourism business established in marine waters for more than 30 days under the published business rules.

jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Operator approval is a business requirement. The cited pages do not confirm that it replaces any client or local water permission.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Ask the local fisheries office and the operator to confirm personal and location requirements.

sources.title: Government Regulation 28/2025, fishing tourism business requirements

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm individual visitor permits and marine park or local access rules. No personal licence exemption is verified.

jurisdictions.name: Japan
jurisdictions.summary: Inland fishing can require a local cooperative's fishing ticket and compliance with prefectural rules. Foreign visitors also face specific boat restrictions; one river's ticket does not give access to another.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers who target species covered by a local cooperative's recreational fishing rules.

extras.name: Local cooperative fishing ticket
extras.when: Where the river or lake cooperative requires a fee and fishing approval.

jurisdictions.saltwater: Foreign visitors may use permitted small-scale shore methods. Boat fishing has additional foreign-national restrictions and prefectural rules.
jurisdictions.guidedTrips: For foreign visitors on boats of 3 gross tons or more, the agency specifies a Japanese vessel controlled by a Japanese fisher.

Do not fish in prohibited or protected areas.
Use permitted shore sites and follow the local boat-fishing rules.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Apply for the Abu Dhabi licence through the TAMM website or app.

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm visitor application requirements and the rules in each other emirate. Abu Dhabi applicants must be at least 18.

jurisdictions.name: Vanuatu
jurisdictions.summary: Private recreational fishing is exempt from the commercial fishing licence under the published tuna plan. Commercial game-fishing vessels use a local fishing licence; confirm local access before your trip.
exemptions: Private recreational and subsistence fishing do not require a commercial licence under the published tuna management plan.

extras.name: Local fishing vessel licence
extras.when: For commercial game-fishing operations.

jurisdictions.guidedTrips: The Fisheries Act provides a local vessel licence for game-fishing operations. Confirm any separate client requirement with the department.
keyRules: Do not take protected turtles, dugongs, whales or dolphins.
Do not take egg-bearing lobsters.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Ask the Fisheries Department to confirm the charter's licence and any local access permission.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm whether any current personal angler or customary-area permit applies; a commercial-licence exemption is not unrestricted access.

jurisdictions.name: Vietnam
jurisdictions.summary: Vietnam's Fisheries Law requires a fishing licence for fishing vessels at least 6 metres long. This vessel rule does not confirm a personal licence requirement for visiting anglers. Check the local water and the operator's permissions before you fish.
whoNeedsOne: Fishing vessels with a maximum length of at least 6 metres require a fishing licence under Article 50.

extras.name: Fishing vessel licence
extras.when: For fishing vessels at least 6 metres long; this is a vessel requirement.

jurisdictions.guidedTrips: Ask the operator to confirm the boat's required licence and permission for the fishing area. Personal visitor requirements are not confirmed.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Ask the provincial fisheries authority about the exact water and fishing activity.

sources.title: Ministry of Justice legal database — Fisheries Law, Article 50

jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm personal visitor requirements, shore and freshwater access, protected-area permission and current fees.

jurisdictions.name: Zambia
jurisdictions.summary: The official licence registry lists a monthly recreational permit for non-residents. A lodge's institutional angling permit is a separate category; confirm whether your trip includes personal permission.
whoNeedsOne: Non-residents who apply for recreational fishing permission.

extras.name: Institutional angling permit
extras.when: A separate permit category for lodges, camps and hotels.

jurisdictions.howToBuy: Contact the Department of Fisheries at the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock.
jurisdictions.checkOfficial: Confirm the current fee, seasonal closures, park permissions and whether the lodge permit covers you.

jurisdictions.name: Zimbabwe

authority.name: Zimbabwe Parks and Wildlife Management Authority

jurisdictions.summary: ZimParks issues fishing permits for waters under its rules. A general angling-society block permit excludes Chimanimani and Rhodes Inyanga National Parks, so check your exact water.
whoNeedsOne: Anglers in waters where ZimParks requires a fishing permit.
keyRules: Follow the species and catch limits on your permit.
Submit a catch return if the permit or an officer requires it.
jurisdictions.howToBuy: Obtain the permit from ZimParks; Kariba's fisheries institute and local ZimParks offices issue daily permits.
